summary: Converts unsigned 16-bit grayscale texture data from a row/slice-addressed source buffer into 32-bit float RGBA output where R = G = B = luminance (uint16 * 0.000015259022) and A = 1.0, then optionally runs a post-process cleanup over the decoded output when the object's +0x10 flag is set.

local_names.this: object carrying source data pointer and row/slice strides
local_names.a2: row index into the source buffer
local_names.a3: slice index into the source buffer
local_names.v4: walking source pointer over uint16 words
local_names.v8: uint16 source grayscale value being decoded
local_names.v7: scaled luminance value written to R, G and B

operations.description: Compute the source buffer base: this+0x18 plus a3 slices (stride this+0x1054) plus a2 rows (stride this+0x1050).
Iterate this+0x1058 source uint16 grayscale values, emitting one float4 per value.
Read the uint16 luminance value and scale it by 0.000015259022.
Write the scaled luminance to the R, G and B output slots (a4[0], a4[1], a4[2]).
Write A = 1.0 into the alpha output slot on every loop iteration.
When the object flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, run the post-process step over the decoded output buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup with the object and the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
